versions.changelog:
Initial release of html-ppt-skill:  
- Create fully responsive HTML-based slideshows as a modern PPT alternative.
- Enforces strict 16:9 ratio for all slides using CSS scroll-snap.
- Built-in navigation (keyboard, scroll, on-screen controls) and PDF export via browser print.
- Always triggers for requests mentioning making PPT/slides/decks, even if the user doesn't specify format.
- Standardized structure, styling, and design guidelines for professional-quality slides.
